summary: Vesta filed a 6-K announcing a proposed follow-on global public offering of 70,047,634 common shares (incl. ADSs). Barclays, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley are joint global coordinators. The offering includes a U.S./international tranche under an automatically effective F-3 shelf and a Mexican transe pending CNBV approval. No specific price or terms are disclosed. This is a routine capital raise via a takedown off an existing shelf registration, not a special situation like a restructuring or going-private transaction. What to watch: pricing and demand in the concurrent U.S. and Mexico offerings.
